currentObjective: Core BCL known-operation mappings implemented without LINQ mappings or new diagnostics
decisions: Known operations must be resolved through Roslyn symbols, not text-only method names.
Unsupported or unresolved invocations remain Unknown; the inherited conservative O(n) fallback is explicitly rejected.
Known operation mappings carry complexity, execution semantics, provenance, and diagnostic metadata.
KnownOperationMapping, KnownOperationRegistry, and KnownOperationResolver were added under Analysis/KnownOperations with immutable value-oriented model objects and no Roslyn dependency under Model/.
The registry is immutable after construction, deterministic by sorted mapping identity, read-only for callers, and has no I/O, reflection, or mutable global state.
Resolver lookup starts from IMethodSymbol, normalizes original definitions, handles reduced extension methods, and uses SymbolEqualityComparer where symbol-definition comparison is needed.
KnownOperationResolver also resolves getter/indexer IPropertySymbol values through accessor identities such as get_Count, get_Item, and get_Length.

KnownOperationRegistry.Bcl contains only verified core BCL mappings: List<T>.Count/indexer/Contains/IndexOf/Sort, Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.ContainsKey/ContainsValue, HashSet<T>.Contains, Array.Length, and string.Length.
Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.ContainsKey and HashSet<T>.Contains store O(1) as Average-case metadata instead of silently treating hash-based lookup as worst-case O(1).
No LINQ mappings and no public diagnostics were added in step 3.
LINQ deferred pipeline creation must not be charged as full enumeration until supported consumption is observed.
Initial scope prioritizes small BCL/LINQ subsets with verifiable provenance rather than full parity with inherited mappings.
BIG0001 is specified as Info and disabled by default; BIG100x diagnostics start conservatively and must minimize false positives.
constraints: Do not modify inherited projects outside analyzer/.
Do not create ProjectReference, binary reference, local package dependency, or transitive dependency on inherited projects.
Do not copy the inherited BCL registry wholesale.
Do not implement call graph, interprocedural analysis, recursion, recurrence solving, Workspaces, CodeFix, memory complexity, parallel complexity, or probabilistic complexity in Phase 4.
Do not change BIG9000 unless a later explicit spec changes that contract.
Respect CancellationToken and keep analyzer hot paths deterministic, immutable, and free from I/O, network access, process execution, and reflection-heavy behavior.
validations: Phase 3 was verified from code and tests before creating the Phase 4 specification.
Release tests passed for the analyzer workspace before documentation edits.

Known-operation infrastructure tests cover exact match, unknown lookup, overload distinction, custom same-name non-match, reduced extension resolution, deterministic registry ordering, concurrent read behavior, and Unknown not becoming O(n).

Core BCL mapping tests cover List<T>.Count/indexer/Contains/IndexOf/Sort overloads, Dictionary<TKey,TValue>.ContainsKey/ContainsValue, HashSet<T>.Contains, Array.Length, string.Length, custom homonymous List<T>.Contains, verified or explicitly conservative provenance, and absence of LINQ mappings.
